column1: # Conformance fixture for the notation grammar in PLAN section 3.
# This file is the grammar's only source of truth. Both this library and
# fpdb's Python parser read it, so that two implementations of one grammar
#   arg      hand: how many cards the game deals a player
#            hand_up_to: as hand, but a short field is allowed -- the rest of
#            the cards are still to come (stud dealt street by street, a draw
#            board: the most cards the board can hold
#   result   ok: the canonical rendering; err: the error's stable name
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# --- 3.1 case is folded, output is canonical --------------------------------
# --- 3.2 a rank binds to a suit that immediately follows it -----------------
# --- 3.3 ranges, only where a hand holds two cards --------------------------

Ac Kd, Ac Kh, Ac Ks, Ad Kc, Ad Kh, Ad Ks, Ah Kc, Ah Kd, Ah Ks, As Kc, As Kd, As Kh
